notes.title: Dev Brawl!
notes.notes:
[b]Dev Brawl! 0.01[/b]
[u]Brawler BOTS! Inches away from release![/u]

[h1]Major Items Off Our List![/h1]
[list]
[*]All items implemented into the shop & usable
[*]Maps 1-62 implemented and ready to Brawl on!
[*]Robot Sano added and ready to take damage for your party!
[*]Battle pass for exclusive gear 
[*]Online servers up and running ready for all you gamers to enjoy!
[*]Pvp... almost ready! 
[/list]

We are super excited to be releasing our Cover Game for Top Knock Game Studios very soon! We appreciate everyone who has joined us along the journey for Brawler BOTS!! to release! 
After over a year of work , it will be ready to play very very soon! We thank everyone for joining us and stay on the look out for new games from our studio and tons of huge updates to Brawler BOTS! 

Did you know? That you can get early access to Brawler BOTS! Before its on steam? Go to our official discord today and be granted access the second Brawler BOTS! Closed beta is live you will be dm'd a link to download! All progress will be saved when played on steam on later release date! Oh , you also get never to be obtained again Closed Beta Gear!

-Sneaky Peaky at Closed Beta Cosmetic Helmet

[url=https://www.topknockgames.com/][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/7455d4_7a1a0e6938d4419aab437b92162f5d1d~mv2.png/v1/fit/w_1420,h_641,q_90/7455d4_7a1a0e6938d4419aab437b92162f5d1d~mv2.webp[/img][/url]

We have also been updating everyone via youtube! There we showcase map previews and new features being added to the game! We plan to do more in depth videos soon showing how some things are developed for those wanting to make there own games as well!
